description: Kintore Town House, a historic stone civic building with an external stair and small steeple, in a Scottish town square.
Spinifex hummock grassland in the red Australian desert, low spiny grass rings.
A rusting shipwreck half-buried in sand on a foggy Namibian desert beach.
A Welwitschia mirabilis plant with two long tattered strap leaves sprawling over gravel in the Namib Desert.
A computer simulation visualisation of a network of branching neurons firing.
A 19th-century-style medical illustration of a patient hallucinating insects and creatures.
Microscopy-style image of a mast cell, a round cell packed with dark purple granules.
Cardiac surgeons performing open-heart bypass surgery under operating lights.
Electron-micrograph-style image of round herpesvirus particles with spiky envelopes.
Fundoscopy view of a swollen, blurred-edge optic disc at the back of the eye.
A glossy black crow holding a thin hooked twig tool in its bill, perched on a branch.
A sea otter floating on its back in calm water, holding a rock on its chest.
A pink axolotl salamander with feathery external gills, side view.
A vintage 1944 science book cover titled What Is Life? by Erwin Schrodinger, mid-century typography.
A dignified 19th-century portrait painting of William Rowan Hamilton, an Irish gentleman scholar.
Bright coloured emission spectral lines of elements on a black background, like a spectroscope view.
A rough specimen of phosphate rock with pale apatite mineral.
Purple cubic fluorite crystals on a rock matrix.
An underground chapel carved from salt inside a mine, with salt chandeliers and statues.
A clean chemical structure diagram of the steroid hormone ecdysone on a white background.
